feeling_the_flow.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was varied and flexible, responding to many signals at once. With entrainment, the heart followed the breath into a strong, steady rise and fall.
feeling_the_flow.implication: Relaxed and ready at rest, and able to settle deeply when guided. This is the pattern you want.
feeling_the_flow.goal: Nothing to change. The system is working well.
feeling_the_flow.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was varied and flexible, responding to many signals at once.
feeling_the_flow.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart followed the breath into a strong, steady rise and fall.
feeling_the_flow.takeaway: Nothing to change. The system is working well.

fragile_calm.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was varied and flexible. With entrainment, the heart followed the breath, but the rise and fall stayed gentle.
fragile_calm.implication: The system settled when guided, but without much depth behind it.
fragile_calm.goal: A fine result. A slower or longer session may let the response deepen.
fragile_calm.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was varied and flexible.
fragile_calm.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart followed the breath, but the rise and fall stayed gentle.
fragile_calm.takeaway: A fine result. A slower or longer session may let the response deepen.

laser_focus.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was tightly controlled, driven by only a few signals rather than resting broadly. With entrainment, the heart still followed the breath strongly.
laser_focus.implication: The resting state was narrow and focused, yet the system was still very responsive when guided.
laser_focus.goal: Strong response. If the resting rhythm is this tight often, notice whether you are resting as broadly as you could.
laser_focus.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was tightly controlled, driven by only a few signals rather than resting broadly.
laser_focus.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart still followed the breath strongly.
laser_focus.takeaway: Strong response. If the resting rhythm is this tight often, notice whether you are resting as broadly as you could.

attentive.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was tightly controlled, driven by only a few signals. With entrainment, the heart followed the breath, but only gently.
attentive.implication: A narrow resting state with a light response. Engaged, but not settling deeply.
attentive.goal: If the resting rhythm is consistently this tight, consider whether you are entering sessions already keyed-up rather than relaxed.
attentive.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was tightly controlled, driven by only a few signals.
attentive.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart followed the breath, but only gently.
attentive.takeaway: If the resting rhythm is consistently this tight, consider whether you are entering sessions already keyed-up rather than relaxed.

stuck.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was tightly controlled and rigid. With entrainment, the rhythm barely changed.
stuck.implication: When the resting state is already locked tight, there is little room left to shift. The breath could not move a system that was already fixed.
stuck.goal: Step back and rest. Let the resting rhythm loosen before trying again.
stuck.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was tightly controlled and rigid.
stuck.entrainment: With entrainment, the rhythm barely changed.
stuck.takeaway: Step back and rest. Let the resting rhythm loosen before trying again.

relying_on_reserves.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was unsettled and disorganized. With entrainment, the heart still followed the breath into a strong, steady rhythm.
relying_on_reserves.implication: The resting state was rough, yet the system responded fully when guided. This is a strong response, common while recovering from a heavy stretch: the capacity is there even though things have not settled.
relying_on_reserves.goal: Encouraging, but protect recovery. The system is still doing repair work; favor rest over more load.
relying_on_reserves.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was unsettled and disorganized.
relying_on_reserves.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart still followed the breath into a strong, steady rhythm.
relying_on_reserves.takeaway: Encouraging, but protect recovery. The system is still doing repair work; favor rest over more load.

running_low.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was unsettled and disorganized. With entrainment, the heart began to follow but could not fully settle into the rhythm.
running_low.implication: The system is working to respond, but limited reserves are holding it back. This is effort against a headwind, not failure.
running_low.goal: Ease the load. A shorter session or a more comfortable pace may help.
running_low.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was unsettled and disorganized.
running_low.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart began to follow but could not fully settle into the rhythm.
running_low.takeaway: Ease the load. A shorter session or a more comfortable pace may help.

running_on_fumes.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was unsettled and disorganized. With entrainment, the heart did not fall into step with the breath.
running_on_fumes.implication: Neither settled at rest nor responsive when guided. The system is running on empty right now.
running_on_fumes.goal: Rest. Even slow breathing is a demand at the moment. Stop for now; if it persists, consider illness, stress, or fatigue.
running_on_fumes.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was unsettled and disorganized.
running_on_fumes.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart did not fall into step with the breath.
running_on_fumes.takeaway: Rest. Even slow breathing is a demand at the moment. Stop for now; if it persists, consider illness, stress, or fatigue.

tug_of_war.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was its usual self. With entrainment, the heart pushed hard but the rise and fall did not line up cleanly with the breath.
tug_of_war.implication: There was plenty of power, but it did not organize into a smooth rhythm. Common right after waking, after deep recovery, or if the breathing pace was off.
tug_of_war.goal: Give it time. Wait 10-15 minutes and retry, or check that the breathing pace is slow and steady.
tug_of_war.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was its usual self.
tug_of_war.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart pushed hard but the rise and fall did not line up cleanly with the breath.
tug_of_war.takeaway: Give it time. Wait 10-15 minutes and retry, or check that the breathing pace is slow and steady.

surfing_the_wave.physiology: At rest, the calming side of the nervous system was already running very high ({b_rmssd} ms). With entrainment, there was little room left to rise further.
surfing_the_wave.implication: When rest is already this deep, a small measured change does not mean a weak response. The system was simply near its ceiling to begin with.
surfing_the_wave.goal: No correction needed. Read this as abundance, not a poor result.
surfing_the_wave.baseline: At rest, the calming side of the nervous system was already running very high ({b_rmssd} ms).
surfing_the_wave.entrainment: With entrainment, there was little room left to rise further.
surfing_the_wave.takeaway: No correction needed. Read this as abundance, not a poor result.

burned_out.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm started out varied and flexible. With entrainment, the rhythm became less organized rather than more.
burned_out.implication: The session was met as a stressor rather than a release. The body tightened under the effort instead of settling.
burned_out.goal: Reduce pressure. Stop for now and try a gentler approach later.
burned_out.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm started out varied and flexible.
burned_out.entrainment: With entrainment, the rhythm became less organized rather than more.
burned_out.takeaway: Reduce pressure. Stop for now and try a gentler approach later.
